sources.title: RTEC Job Application Template - Digital Version
sources.kind: digitalized application template with Transit Driver job-description reference section
sources.source_role: current-accessible application template derived from/reference-linked older material

application_schema_safe: separate applicant-data/affirmative-action survey in historical source
currentness_hazards: The PDF embeds a Transit Driver job description dated 2011.
The historical embedded job description contains benefit/eligibility statements that conflict with later handbook evidence, including older medical and 401(k) timing.
The historical application directs completed forms to an old rtec@kih.net email address.
A file modification/upload date in 2026 does not make embedded 2011 job-description, benefit, contact, or qualification text current.
scanner_and_agent_rules: Classify application pages separately from embedded job-description/reference pages.
Use current canonical job descriptions for qualifications and essential duties; never inherit job-description currentness from the application packet.
Use current handbook/plan sources for benefits; ignore embedded legacy benefit bullets for current decisions.
Treat applicant-data/affirmative-action survey pages as restricted demographic applicant records when completed.
Current application channel/contact instructions must come from current ATS/recruiting configuration, not the historical rtec@kih.net instruction.
Preserve the 2011 Transit Driver reference text as historical provenance only.
automation_implications: Applicant Dashboard packet generation should compose the current application template and current job-description version as separate versioned components.
Scanner should split mixed packets by document class/page sequence so an application can be current while an appended job-description page is historical.
Version/effective-date checks should block legacy embedded benefit text from becoming a current knowledge claim.
